LanguageData.VRE_AntibioticsAddiction.description: A chemical addiction to antibiotics. Long-term presence of antibiotics has caused neurological adaptations at the cellular level, so the brain can no longer function properly without the drug. \nWithout regular doses of antibiotics, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the brain to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.
LanguageData.VRE_AntibioticsAddiction.label: antibiotics addiction
LanguageData.VRE_AntibioticsAddiction.stages.1.label: withdrawal
LanguageData.VRE_AntibioticsHigh.description: A drug for boosting the immune system after infections take hold. Helps against diseases, such as malaria and plague, as well as infections due to unclean wounds. Lasts 12 hours. Effect is stronger depending on the severity of the immunity genes of the ingester (stronger for less immune subjects), and it is modified by the person's tolerance to the drug.
LanguageData.VRE_AntibioticsHigh.label: antibiotics
